model_name: POLARIS Sea-Ice Multimodal Bounded Residual CNN v0.3
selection_reason: ADOPT_V03: lower MAE at all horizons, zero clipping, initialization-only forcing and training-only normalization. Paired bootstrap evidence reported separately.
limitations: ERA5 is historical reanalysis, not an operational weather forecast.
Validation still improving at epoch 30; no retraining after locked evaluation.
Daily IID bootstrap does not account for serial correlation.
